title: Terraform state backend
description: Schema for <env>/state-backend.yaml — the environment's Terraform state location (operator plane, sibling of .env; NOT a capability — it has no provider role and no gitops consumer). Absent file = local state under artifacts/<env>/state/ (the historical layout). The engine generates the actual backend config per stack from this file (backend blocks cannot interpolate). Credentials come from .env: STATE_S3_ACCESS_KEY / STATE_S3_SECRET_KEY. Hub environments use the tooling MinIO (same trust domain as backups); the tooling environment cannot store state in the MinIO it creates — it uses external S3 or stays local with mandatory backup. State is more sensitive than backups (all secrets in plaintext): private + versioned bucket; locking via the S3-native lockfile (Terraform >= 1.10 conditional writes — verify the serving MinIO release supports If-None-Match PUT).

type.description: Backend type. 'local' keeps the two state files under artifacts/<env>/state/ (must then be backed up out of band); 's3' stores them in the named S3-compatible bucket.

endpoint.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL, stated outright (e.g. the tooling MinIO: https://s3.int.<tooling-domain>). Omit or leave empty for real AWS S3 (the region selects the endpoint).

bucket.description: Bucket name — private and versioned; state carries every platform secret in plaintext. On a tooling MinIO, declare it via the tooling env's object_storage.buckets (access key = bucket name; 'make secrets' prints the secret key to copy into STATE_S3_ACCESS_KEY/SECRET_KEY).

region.description: Region for SigV4 signing. MinIO accepts its configured region (commonly us-east-1); AWS S3 needs the bucket's real region.

key_prefix.description: Object key prefix for the two state files (<prefix>/infra.tfstate, <prefix>/config.tfstate). Defaults to the environment name.

use_lockfile.description: S3-native lockfile locking (Terraform >= 1.10). Default true. Requires the endpoint to honor conditional writes (If-None-Match) — verify against the deployed MinIO release.
